name: Jian
description: A star 112 parsecs away, 37 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: radius 37.091 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 573.93 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.08) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: effective temperature 4642 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.041)

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93085: distance 111.982 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.059), at which the luminosity and radius hold

limb.none: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15)

text.card: A star 112 parsecs away, 37 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 574 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,642 K, so 37.091 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 93085: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Xi2 Sagittarii
quotes.card: Xi2 Sagittarii, also named Jian, is a star in the zodiac constellation of Sagittarius.
quotes.introduction: Data collected during the Hipparcos mission suggests it is an astrometric binary, although nothing is known about the companion.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4084834822776246272 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none
